description:
Score an agent output with the deterministic rules: a ship verdict with its basis, per-rule evidence, and what was not judged.

What it does. Local, no key. eval_type picks a bundle or all (the default). A rule missing its input SKIPS, never passes: input is REQUIRED when eval_type="relevance"; tool_calls and tools (or a trace_id), cost_usd and expected feed the rest. Full detail: iris://capabilities.

When not to use it. For semantic judgment (evaluate_with_llm_judge). As an input firewall: the rules read the output.

Returns. JSON: id, trace_id, verdict, coverage, provenance, run_id, interpretations, erased_at, eval_type, score, passed, rule_results, rules_evaluated, rules_skipped, insufficient_data, critical_failures, critical_skipped, categories, note, rules_changed.

Errors. IRIS_UNKNOWN_TRACE (nothing written); IRIS_STORAGE_ERROR. Failures return {"error":{code,message,recovery}} with isError; follow recovery.

Siblings. log_trace — record the execution first; list_rules — what each rule needs.

cost_usd.description: Cost in USD, for the cost bundle and any cost_threshold rule; omitted, they skip rather than pass

custom_rules.description: Up to 10 one-off rules; they fire whatever eval_type is (eval_type="custom" runs only these)

config.description: Check configuration; keys depend on type (pattern, min_length, keywords, max_cost, …)

name.description: Rule name as it will appear in rule_results

severity.description: high or critical: a failure fails the verdict; otherwise it advises

type.description: Check type — decides which config keys the rule reads

weight.description: Weight in the weighted score (default 1; must be > 0)

eval_type.description: Rule bundle: completeness | relevance | safety | cost | custom | all (the default, noted in the response)

expected.description: Expected output for comparison — consulted only by the completeness bundle's expected_coverage rule; NOT used by relevance (the relevance rules compare the output against `input`)

expected_trajectory.description: What the agent was expected to DO: tool_calls with mode and args (tool_sequence); step_budget and tolerance (step_budget)

input.description: The ask and any source material given — REQUIRED when eval_type="relevance"; also grounds the hallucination signals

output.description: The output text to evaluate (the agent's response that gets scored against rules)

token_usage.description: Token usage breakdown — only consulted by the cost bundle (eval_type="cost" or "all"; used for token-budget rules)

tool_calls.description: The tool calls the agent made, in order, as log_trace records them; omitted, the trajectory rules skip. Loaded from trace_id when stored

tools.description: Your MCP tools/list result, verbatim; lets the rules check call arguments. Loaded from trace_id when stored

trace_id.description: Link evaluation to a trace — surfaces this eval in the dashboard's trace drill-through and lets the tool reuse the trace's stored tool_calls. Must be the id of a stored trace (from log_trace / get_traces); an unknown id is rejected before anything is evaluated

name: evaluate_output
title: Evaluate Output
